projectThesis: RN makes invisible decision systems inspectable.

conferenceLens.capability: AI & Big Data: what the system can compute, automate, retrieve, predict or coordinate.
conferenceLens.experience: Dutch Design Week: how the system becomes perceptible, embodied, material, contestable and culturally legible.
conferenceLens.governance: RN: who has authority, what evidence travels, what consequence follows and where a person can intervene.

series.title: Human Means Authority
series.question: When does a person actually control an AI-assisted outcome?
series.promise: Replace ‘human in the loop’ with an inspectable authority architecture.

series.title: Rules Meet Real Life
series.question: What happens when a policy, technology or service enters an actual place and a person's path?
series.promise: Translate institutional design into visible burden, access, adaptation and recourse.

series.title: Evidence That Stays Alive
series.question: Can someone follow a decision or claim back to what was known, changed and contested?
series.promise: Make research and decisions inspectable after the original conversation ends.

series.title: Access Is a System
series.question: Which product, policy, data and environment conditions determine whether someone can meaningfully use or contest a system?
series.promise: Move accessibility from a checklist into inspectable system behavior.

series.title: Work Becomes Public Infrastructure
series.question: How does private work become reusable public proof without leaking people, rights or confidential material?
series.promise: Show the transformation from research or a work packet to a defensible public artifact.

series.title: Built to Fail Closed
series.question: What must a consequential system do when evidence, permission, infrastructure or confidence is insufficient?
series.promise: Design stop, fallback, rollback and recovery as primary capabilities.

series.title: Island Systems
series.question: What becomes visible when systems are examined from an island rather than treated as placeless?
series.promise: Use island context to expose dependencies, transfer failures, access constraints and resilience tradeoffs.
